sn45.35:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you asceticism and the fruits of asceticism.
sn45.35:1.5: It is this Noble Eightfold Path; that is,
sn45.35:1.8: “And what, bhikkhus, are the fruits of asceticism?
sn45.35:1.9: The fruit of stream-entry, the fruit of once-returning, the fruit of nonreturning, the fruit of arahantship.
sn45.35:1.10: These are called the fruits of asceticism.”
